title: Gladius (Aegis Dynamics, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Gladius is a light fighter and interceptor from Aegis Dynamics, a maker of military-style ships in Star Citizen. The pilot sits alone under a bubble canopy with a wide view for dogfighting. It uses the common Star Citizen controls without changes.

panels.name: Gladius: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Gladius's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (three)
controls.text: The Gladius carries three guns that the pilot aims by pointing the ship and fires himself.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Missile racks (six missiles)
controls.text: Racks on the Gladius hold six missiles for targets that are hard to hit with the guns.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.
